title: RFP Hub registry file
description: The shape of every registry file under packages/standard/registries/. A registry governs one open vocabulary in the standard: the schema keeps the field open (free text), and the registry keeps the values interoperable. Registered values are normative; the schema does not enforce them and unregistered values remain valid. Entries are NEVER deleted — set status to 'deprecated' and point replacedBy at the successor.

description.description: What this value means and when a publisher should use it.

status.description: 'active' = registered and recommended. 'deprecated' = still valid data, no longer recommended; see replacedBy.

since.description: The spec version in which this value was registered.

replacedBy.description: Key of the successor entry, when status is 'deprecated'.

reference.description: A URL supporting the registration (a publisher's own documentation, a governance post).

examples.description: Real values or phrasings seen in the wild for this key. May be empty.
